name: Union University
tuition_note: Private school, single published rate. 2025-26 tuition & fees from official Union University catalog (uu.smartcatalogiq.com 2025-26 Undergraduate Catalogue, Tuition and Fees): tuition 12-16 hrs $19,995/semester = $39,990/yr plus General Student Fee $740/semester = $1,480/yr, total tuition & fees $41,470/yr. Housing room only from same catalog page: Heritage Apartments $4,700/semester = $9,400/yr (lowest standard undergraduate room charge; The Quads $5,100/semester = $10,200/yr). Board/meal plans priced separately. NCES College Navigator (IPEDS 221971) shows 2024-25 tuition & fees $40,025 and combined food & housing $12,780 for reference.
